root_causes: The old model-output contract asked the model to infer and repeat a session identifier.
The old child context exposed a stale reference checkout without making the writable checkout the sole implementation-admission identity.
The old launcher created a synthetic sanitized baseline commit instead of keeping the writable checkout at the pinned canonical HEAD and tree.
corrective_controls: The launcher owns run_id from the run directory.
The transport captures session_id only from the Codex exec thread.started event.
The model output contains neither identifier.
The supervisor injects and validates both identifiers in the result envelope.
The writable checkout begins exactly at the pinned canonical HEAD and tree.
The reference checkout is persisted as read-only evidence only and ignored for admission.
Every implementation Git, test, commit, and patch command is bound to the exact writable checkout path.
audit_note: The earlier revision remains immutable evidence of the failed transport. This revision corrects its attempt accounting and ticket transition.
